mentions.name: XHDR
mentions.description: Tool for displaying HDR profile pictures, built when Twitter briefly allowed HDR profile images before patching it a week later. It still works for Facebook, where the author keeps it up for use in FB video ads because HDR images quickly catch the attention of iPhone users while scrolling.
mentions.source_excerpt: https://xhdr.org/ - Made like a few months back when twitter was allowing HDR images in your profile pictures, they patched it like a week later, but was fun while it lasted. Still works for facebook
